title: Personalise a visitor's store experience
summary: Give visitors a different mobile site menu and campaigns in each zone of a store by creating zone templates and assigning them to the displays there.
bodyMd:
Visitors can get a different mobile site in each part of a store: one menu at the entrance, another in the gaming zone, another at the concierge. You do this by creating a template per zone, assigning it to the displays in that zone, and choosing which campaigns each template's carousel shows. Allow about 30 minutes for a store with 3 zones.

Before you begin

  • Each zone has at least 1 display registered to the store, with QR Control enabled. See Enable QR Control on a display.
  • The default template is defined. See Define your default mobile site template.

Steps

  1. List the zones and what a visitor in each zone needs, for example Store Entrance: join the queue and store hours; Gaming Zone: product pages and offers.
  2. For each zone, create a template with those menu items, following Create a mobile site template for a concierge kiosk. Give a zone template more than 1 menu item unless you want visitors redirected straight to a single URL.
  3. For each display in the zone, assign the zone's template under Enabled Features → QR Control - Mobile Site Template, following Assign a different mobile site template to a store, display or zone. Rename the display after its zone so it is easy to find later.
  4. For each campaign that belongs in a zone, open its Campaign Brief, switch the Store Sites touch-point on and choose that zone's template in Mobile Site Template(s). See Choose which campaigns appear in the campaign carousel.
  5. Give each campaign an onsite banner and call to action, following Create a call to action for on-rotation campaigns.
  6. Walk the store and scan the QR code on a display in each zone.
Triggered campaigns let the visitor control what plays on the display they scanned. See What are triggered campaigns?

Verify it worked

Scanning a display in each zone opens a site with that zone's header, menu items and campaign carousel, and scanning the store's own QR code still opens the store's template. Staff can see what each visitor engaged with under View recent interactions and customer profile data.
